gitCommit.subject: feat(canvas): eraser tool with inpaint mask integration (#1527)
gitCommit.body:
feat(canvas): eraser tool with inpaint mask integration (#1527)

* feat(canvas): add eraser tool with inpaint mask integration

Eraser tool paints non-destructive erase strokes onto images and drawings
via Konva's destination-out composite inside a cached Group. Erase strokes
are merged into the inpaint mask pipeline so erased regions are treated
as fill targets by FLUX Fill / Gemini i2i; the strokes are cleared from
the returned ImageObject since the new bitmap already fills those areas.

* fix(canvas): eraser/sketch inpaint coord alignment and PR review fixes

Address PR #1527 review findings plus two coord-system bugs surfaced
during sketch-inpaint testing:

- mask-export: drop erroneous `points * scaleX` — paint-layer stores
  strokes in world space (already matches canvas size), so the extra
  multiplication pushed strokes off-canvas whenever scaleX != 1.
- mask-export: add `sketchLayerMode` option so sketches painted inside
  eraser holes survive the destination-out step (Gemini i2i needs
  sketch-after-mask; FLUX Fill stays on sketch-before-mask).
- use-canvas-inpainting: scale eraserStrokes from object-local into
  world space when converting to PaintLine so they land on the mask
  canvas at the correct position and size.
- eraser-layer: commit-on-release pattern with preview trail instead of
  per-move store updates — fixes 60fps re-cache thrash on image/drawing
  nodes; add epsilon guard for zero-scale divide; wire window-level
  mouseup / touchend / touchcancel so releases outside the hit region
  still finalize.
- image-node: surface `useImage` failed status via logger + skip erase
  Line rendering when the bitmap didn't load (prevents destination-out
  punching through the stage background).
- action-info forms (remove/ai-edit/expand): strip eraserStrokes when
  replacing src so stale strokes don't misalign with the new bitmap.
- eraser-tool-state: drop unused ERASER_SIZES export; clamp size to
  [2, 512].
- Extract eraser geometry helpers into utils/canvas/eraser-geometry.ts
  for standalone testing.
- Tests: new eraser-tool-state, eraser-layer-geometry suites; extend
  use-canvas-inpainting tests to cover eraserStrokes stripping and
  world-space scaling; update mask-export tests for new layering API.

* feat(canvas): unified sketch color picker (HEX/RGB + eyedropper) (#1528)

* feat(canvas): unify sketch color picker across toolbar and inpaint

Extract a shared ColorPickerControl component used by both the toolbar
drawing tool and the inpaint sketch mode. Adds HEX/RGB input toggle and
an EyeDropper-API eyedropper button (feature-gated, so Safari/Firefox
silently hide it) to both pickers, and replaces the inpaint panel's
native <input type="color"> with the shared popover-based UI.

* fix(canvas): color picker fills popover width + split RGB into 3 channel inputs

Two issues from initial unified picker:
- Inpaint popover's HexColorPicker rendered at its default 200px,
  leaving empty space inside the 256px popover — the width:100% CSS
  override was keyed to `.drawing-color-picker`, a class only applied
  in the toolbar. Renamed to `.canvas-color-picker-surface` and apply
  it by default inside ColorPickerControl so both callers get it.
- RGB mode used one comma-separated text input, which is clumsy to
  edit. Replaced with three independent R/G/B numeric inputs;
  onChange fires only when all three parse as bytes in [0, 255].

* fix(canvas): mark RGB channels with colored 2px borders

R/G/B inputs looked identical in the unified picker, forcing the user
to guess channel order. Give each input a 2px border in its channel
color (R red, G green, B blue) so the border itself acts as the label.

* fix(canvas): widen color-picker popovers so RGB inputs fit 3 digits

w-64 left each RGB channel ~32px of width, which clipped "255" at the
mono text-xs size. Bump both toolbar and inpaint popovers to w-72 so
every channel input comfortably fits a full 3-digit byte value.

* style(canvas): restyle color-picker panel to match 手帳 glass/grid design

Whole popover used to read as a standard opaque shadcn popup, breaking
the airy frosted-glass + blue-grid language that the canvas toolbar and
background already share. Bring the picker into the same system:

- Popover frame: bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl shadow-lg
  ring-1 ring-blue-200/40 so the canvas grid shows through
- Saturation/hue panel: wrap in rounded-xl overflow-hidden + shadow-inner
  with a fixed 180px height; stop bleeding to popover edges
- HEX mode toggle + text input + eyedropper: rounded-full muted glass
  pills, echoing handwritten 手帳 labels
- Preview swatch and color-palette dots: rounded-full with soft shadow
  and a blue ring when selected; hover scales the swatch slightly
- Section headings (顏色 / 不透明度 / 筆刷大小 / 筆刷樣式): prefix a
  2px blue square that mirrors the grid accent; lighter tracking-wide
- Sliders: adopt the existing variant="glass" so thumb and track feel
  like the rest of the canvas UI
- Brush-style cards: rounded-xl + ring instead of full borders, hover
  lifts the card with -translate-y-0.5 for a sticker feel, selected
  state uses the same blue glass tint as the rest of the panel

* style(canvas): restyle inpaint panel to match color-picker glass design

Bring the FloatingInpaintContainer (遮罩/草圖) panel into the same visual
system as the newly redesigned color picker popover:

- Container: rounded-2xl + ring-1 ring-blue-200/40 + bg-background/80
  backdrop-blur-md so the canvas grid breathes through, matching toolbar
  and color popover framing
- ToggleGroup (遮罩/草圖): pill group on a muted track; selected item
  adopts the blue-50 tint + blue-300 ring used elsewhere, replacing the
  heavy black "accent" default that was jarring against the airy base
- Textarea: rounded-xl soft background with muted border, blue focus ring
- Section labels (筆刷顏色 / 筆刷大小 / 去噪強度): blue 2px square dot
  prefix + tracking-wide to echo the color-picker headings
- Sketch-color trigger: rounded-full with shadow-sm + hover scale, so it
  reads as a watercolor dot like the preview swatch in the popover
- All sliders switch to variant="glass"
- Clear button: rounded-full ghost with softer muted bg on hover

* style(canvas): use HighlightTabs for inpaint 遮罩/草圖 tab switcher

Replace the custom pill ToggleGroup with the shared HighlightTabs used
by the video-generation panel (文字生成影片 / 圖片生成影片). Active tab
gets the yellow highlighter-pen underline + azure text, matching the
video panel's handwritten tab pattern.

* style(canvas): add inline quick swatches to inpaint 筆刷顏色 row

The sketch-mode brush-color row had a big visual gap between its label
and the color button. Fill that space with a row of the 8 DEFAULT_BRUSH
colors as tiny 16px dots — one-click shortcut for the most common
sketch colors, keeping the popover for fine tuning. Selected color is
ringed in the same blue treatment used by the popover's swatches.

* fix(canvas): discriminate AbortError in eyedropper and clamp RGB inputs

Address two review findings on the unified color picker:

- EyeDropper catch used to swallow every rejection behind a "user
  canceled" comment, hiding real failures (SecurityError,
  NotAllowedError, etc.) the same way as an intentional user dismiss.
  Now returns silently only on DOMException AbortError and console.warn
  surfaces anything else for debugging.
- RGB channel inputs used to silently drop out-of-range or non-numeric
  edits ("999" stayed in the field, color never updated). Now strips
  non-digits and clamps to [0, 255] so the displayed value and the
  emitted color always agree. Empty string is still allowed so the
  user can clear a channel mid-edit.

Tests updated: the old out-of-range-rejection assertion is replaced by
a clamp assertion; added a non-digit-stripping test.
